parsed.explanation: Combined regime is hostile at federal and state levels: X/non-matching passports barred and upheld, entry discrepancy can trigger refusal and fraud-based permanent ineligibility, and government facilities including schools/colleges require birth-sex use with a documented trespass arrest. If detained, immigration and prison custody document beatings, sexual abuse, forced labour and hormone removal. Courts enjoin some orders and national hate-crime law exists, and execution/imprisonment for mere presentation is not credible, so risk is below the 0.25 tier, but universal facility/document exposure with thin effective remedy keeps it in the 0.35 tier.

entry_documents.exposure: Federal policy bars X and non-birth-sex markers, upheld Nov 2025; cable directs refusal on discrepancy and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation. Passports confiscated/blocked reported.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; civil-liberties suit pending; fraud finding requires four elements and is never automatic.
entry_documents.interaction: Document discrepancy can escalate from entry refusal to fraud investigation and detention, feeding birth-sex custody placement.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody: forced labour, beatings, solitary, severe sexual abuse reported. National corrections model from 2026 mandates hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution; no cell-placement case documented for this state.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Courts have blocked/enjoined several orders; habeas/litigation exists but remedies are slow and incomplete.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Arrest for facility trespass or immigration detention leads into the documented custody-harm system; state freeze-frame treatment policy compounds it.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal government facilities barred congruent access; this state requires public school/college/university restrooms by birth sex, expanded May 2026; 4 states make use criminal in certain circumstances, with first arrest documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: 29 states plus capital have no mapped ban; appellate order allows one student plaintiff bathroom use during litigation; trespass requires willful entry plus refusal to depart.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal and state bans form one universal exposure across government buildings, schools and campuses a visitor must traverse.

care_services.exposure: Minors' gender-affirming care banned in 27 states; proposed national rule would bar public insurance reimbursement under 18; DOJ subpoenaed hospitals for minors' records.
care_services.protection: Several orders blocked/enjoined; proposed health rules unresolved. No operative visitor continuity protection documented.
care_services.interaction: A care-seeking adult or minor faces document/facility exposure in clinics and potential investigation referral.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Executive order defines sex as binary at birth, removes gender-identity policies, directs investigation/prosecution over school social transition; 2026 strategy prioritizes 'radically pro-transgender' groups; diversity of hostile state bills pending.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Employment discrimination barred by 2020 ruling; marriage recognized; some orders enjoined; counterterrorism memo not a criterion for rewards and strategy disclaims targeting mere disagreement.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Official threat-framing increases police/administrative discretion at borders, facilities and schools, raising outing probability and severity.

minors_guardians.exposure: School restroom ban including higher education, sports ban, care bans, and directive to criminally prosecute teachers facilitating social transition; minor traveller faces facilities exclusion and outing at school.
minors_guardians.protection: One student's access protected during litigation; no documented guardian shield statute for travelling families.
minors_guardians.interaction: Parent/guardian cannot shield minor from birth-sex facilities, school verification, or care-access denial; age-dependent rules apply at every government institution.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No documented pattern of street killings or organised targeting of visitors in dossier; poll shows majority support birth-sex document laws. Police arrest for bathroom use documented once.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 22 states plus capital outlaw discrimination; municipal employment protections in several localities.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: State has no hate-crime statute and domestic-violence statutes cover only opposite-sex couples, weakening local recourse despite national law.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport and executive-order challenges unresolved; remedies slow, costly, and many visitors depart before relief; birth-sex definitional laws beyond mapped bans noted as unknown.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Legal-aid FAQ, civil-liberties suits, appellate litigation and some injunctions show courts sometimes work for trans people.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Partial judicial remedy does not cancel operative federal entry/facility enforcement already in effect; uncertainty itself deters travel.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: routine exclusion/humiliation, no credible execution, appeals rarely effective. This case is similar but adds criminal trespass arrest and documented custody abuse, so at or slightly below 0.35.

Lower than 0.55-B: that anchor is mainly administrative refusal/delay with appeal desk. Here facility bans are criminalised in circumstances, entry can trigger permanent fraud ineligibility, and custody abuse is severe.

Higher than 0.25-C: birth-sex prison housing with frequent assaults and raids/extortion is not documented for this state (cell placement deliberately not counted), imprisonment for presentation is uncommon, and courts provide some injunctions.

Materially lower than 0.75-C: that anchor has brief detention, accepted matching passports and working appeals. Here matching documents are barred federally and state facilities exclude by birth sex with no working override.

parsed.synthesis: Exposure dominates: every trans visitor faces birth-sex document/facility rules federally and in this state, entry discrepancy can become fraud/detention, and custody harm is documented as severe. Protections are real but partial and litigated—injunctions, national hate-crime and employment law, municipal protections—yet they do not pre-empt operative border, facility or custody enforcement. Minors face added school, sports and care bans with no travelling-family shield. No execution pathway is documented, keeping the score above 0.25, but universal Tier-1 exposure keeps it near 0.35.
